checks.name: All three camera modes and height/zoom/FOV controls persist after reload
Broadcast height raises the view and TV zoom narrows the lens
Camera settings open from pause and return to the same paused match
First-person drag changes view and forward movement follows that view
First-person hides the controlled rig and updates it after player switching
Cancel quit preserves match identity, score and paused clock, then resumes
Confirm quit clears offline state/input and the quit screen returns home
Main-menu Quit game uses the same cancellable confirmation
Cancel online quit preserves the live connection while authority continues
Confirm online quit releases transport and cannot resurrect the match
